value: NCBI SRA PRJNA1372455: RNA-seq of isolated cardiomyocytes at 1, 2, 4 and 7 days after TAC or sham surgery
limma-voom, TAC versus sham at each time point, on the GENCODE vM25 annotation (all biotypes)
40 lincRNAs modulated in at least one post-TAC time point, of which 15 up-regulated and 25 down-regulated
bedtools closest v2.31.1 on GENCODE vM25: -D ref, -id / -iu, -io (overlaps excluded), -t first
retained if up-regulated AND at least one flanking coding gene modulated; trajectory concordance recorded but not used for selection

flanking genes are reported in one of three states. 'modulated': significant at one or more time points. 'tested, not modulated': expressed and tested, but not significant at any time point. 'not expressed': below the edgeR filterByExpr expression filter and therefore never tested, which is not the same as tested and found unchanged
